title: Compare development evidence
scenario: Offline evaluation accounting with Python 3.11+, no credentials or model calls. Inputs and grades are public development evidence, never unseen holdouts.

steps.title: Freeze the complete comparison
steps.instruction: Open the improvement-eval map entry. Run evaluation.py qualify, then freeze a reviewed spec containing both arms, reproduction/counterpart cases, repetitions, exact identities and time/token/request budgets. Save the frozen JSON before collecting completions.
steps.caption: Actual upper portion of the local catalog dialog; follow its source link for the full contract.
steps.expected: One stable inventory identifies every scheduled trial. No agent or command is launched.

steps.title: Retain failures and unknowns
steps.instruction: Run evaluation.py report with the frozen experiment, unchanged current spec and supplied synthetic completions. Inspect trial rows, missing/duplicate counts, critical violations and unknown usage before reading aggregate scores.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered summary from the actual synthetic CLI smoke; not a terminal capture.
steps.expected: Eight scheduled trials remain visible: four pass, one fail, two blocked and one inconclusive. Unknown tokens remain null. Live eligibility is false and promotion is inconclusive.
